```yaml
name: Claude PR Review
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  review-pr:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-pr'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install anthropic
          pip install pygithub
          
      - name: Run PR Review
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python -c "
import os
import sys
from github import Github
import anthropic

# Initialize clients
gh = Github(os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN'])
client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])

# Get PR info
repo = gh.get_repo(os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'])
pr = repo.get_pull(int(os.environ['GITHUB_PULL_REQUEST_NUMBER'])) if 'GITHUB_PULL_REQUEST_NUMBER' in os.environ else None

if pr:
    # Get PR files
    files = []
    for file in pr.get_files():
        files.append({
            'filename': file.filename,
            'patch': file.patch
        })
    
    # Get PR description and title
    title = pr.title
    body = pr.body
    
    # Create prompt for Claude
    prompt = f'''Review this pull request for the repository {os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}.

Title: {title}
Description: {body}

Files changed:
{chr(10).join([f'{f[\"filename\"]}: {f[\"patch\"][:500]}...' for f in files])}

Provide a detailed code review focusing on:
1. Code quality and best practices
2. Potential bugs or issues
3. Performance improvements
4. Security considerations
5. Documentation and clarity

Format your response as a comprehensive review with specific suggestions for each file.'''
    
    # Call Claude API
    response = client.messages.create(
        model='claude-3-opus-20240229',
        max_tokens=2000,
        messages=[
            {
                'role': 'user',
                'content': prompt
            }
        ]
    )
    
    # Post review as comment
    review_comment = response.content[0].text
    pr.create_issue_comment(review_comment)
"

  review-pr-ci:
    if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-pr-ci')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install anthropic
          pip install pygithub
          
      - name: Run CI PR Review
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python -c "
import os
import sys
from github import Github
import anthropic

# Initialize clients
gh = Github(os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN'])
client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])

# Get PR info
repo = gh.get_repo(os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'])
pr = repo.get_pull(int(os.environ['GITHUB_PULL_REQUEST_NUMBER'])) if 'GITHUB_PULL_REQUEST_NUMBER' in os.environ else None

if pr:
    # Get PR files
    files = []
    for file in pr.get_files():
        files.append({
            'filename': file.filename,
            'patch': file.patch
        })
    
    # Get PR description and title
    title = pr.title
    body = pr.body
    
    # Create prompt for Claude
    prompt = f'''Review this pull request for the repository {os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}.

Title: {title}
Description: {body}

Files changed:
{chr(10).join([f'{f[\"filename\"]}: {f[\"patch\"][:500]}...' for f in files])}

Provide a detailed code review focusing on:
1. Code quality and best practices
2. Potential bugs or issues
3. Performance improvements
4. Security considerations
5. Documentation and clarity

Format your response as a comprehensive review with specific suggestions for each file.
This is a CI-only review - no interactive components needed.'''
    
    # Call Claude API
    response = client.messages.create(
        model='claude-3-opus-20240229',
        max_tokens=2000,
        messages=[
            {
                'role': 'user',
                'content': prompt
            }
        ]
    )
    
    # Post review as comment
    review_comment = response.content[0].text
    pr.create_issue_comment(review_comment)
"

  review-issue:
    if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-issue')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install anthropic
          pip install pygithub
          
      - name: Review Issue
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python -c "
import os
import re
from github import Github
import anthropic

# Initialize clients
gh = Github(os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN'])
client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])

# Extract issue number from command
issue_number_match = re.search(r'/review-issue\s+(\d+)', os.environ['GITHUB_COMMENT_BODY'])
if not issue_number_match:
    print('Could not extract issue number from command')
    exit(1)

issue_number = int(issue_number_match.group(1))

# Get issue info
repo = gh.get_repo(os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'])
issue = repo.get_issue(number=issue_number)

# Get issue content
title = issue.title
body = issue.body

# Create prompt for Claude
prompt = f'''Analyze this GitHub issue for the repository {os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}.

Title: {title}
Body: {body}

Classify this issue and provide:
1. Issue classification (spam, bug, proposal, question, community resource, duplicate)
2. Analysis of content and context
3. Suggested labels
4. Appropriate response draft
5. If it's a community resource, suggest redirecting to Discord or Reddit

Format your response clearly with these sections.'''
    
# Call Claude API
response = client.messages.create(
    model='claude-3-opus-20240229',
    max_tokens=2000,
    messages=[
        {
            'role': 'user',
            'content': prompt
        }
    ]
)

# Post analysis as comment
analysis_comment = response.content[0].text
issue.create_comment(analysis_comment)
"
```
